On xy>=0, two-coordinate lp/l2 inequalities give 1+tau<=H_tau^2/Np^2<=4tau; on xy<=0, exact rational ratio 4(s^2+tau)/(1+s)^2 has derivative 8(s-tau)/(1+s)^3 and bounds m=4tau/(1+tau), M=4tau. This is an infinite proof for all real p>2.

value.rationale: The Ptolemy constant is a natural four-point invariant of the classical Day--James family. The claim provides an exact value for a full continuous regime 2<p<infinity (not just a finite sample), a uniform sharp three-point construction and an exact relation with a separately known James constant. Value is narrow/modest but substantive.
